يستأجر (form X)
# يَسْتَأْجِرُ (yastaʔjiru) /jas.taʔ.d͡ʒi.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَأْجَرَ (istaʔjara)
# يُسْتَأْجَرُ (yustaʔjaru) /jus.taʔ.d͡ʒa.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَأْجَرَ (istaʔjara)
# يَسْتَأْجِرَ (yastaʔjira) /jas.taʔ.d͡ʒi.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْت
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
